ladder.limit: none on reads (100% from the cache); landing took ~2.5 min more: one landing queue per copy
Artifacts reads slow past ~2,000/s (p90 1.2 s, worst copy 2.9 s), none failed; landing took ~3 min more: one landing queue per copy

ladder.readCache: every file different per copy (realistic), 3 namespaces, faster start and landing
ladder.limit: Artifacts reads for the whole account, ~1,900-2,000/s: 3 namespaces did not raise it (reads waited longer, none failed). Landing no longer the wall (~1 min after the answers). Behind it: one Run object per copy hands out work (at most ~2,800 reading at once)

tenK.say: 10,000 agents on Cloudflare, every file different, 0 errors: all 29,890 changes on main 86 s after the start (~1,900 files a second at the busiest; Artifacts reads slow down but never fail, and that read rate, ~2,000/s for the account, is the wall).
tenK.always: Cached answers (no model calls). Agents start in ramps: at most ~2,800 of the 10,000 were busy at once.
tenK.not: The read cache did not raise the realistic throughput (1,900 vs the 2,100 plateau without it): not 'the fix'. More namespaces did not raise it either: the read limit is for the account.
